summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening proposals and fees were negotiated alongside class relief from the outset. Class counsel considered its own fee economics, but the transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for fees or defense leveraging fees to reduce relief. Defense repeatedly identified Whitcombe Reyes as the lowest-total option and ultimately settled with that counsel, supporting reverse-auction tactics under the provided definition. The court declaration accurately disclosed that fees and class relief were discussed together.
